functions.spark_sql: SELECT id,approx_percentile(a,0.5,1) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a_value,approx_percentile(b,0.5,1) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS b_value FROM bench ORDER BY id
functions.restricted_input_sql: SELECT id,CAST(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN 9 WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 5 END AS DOUBLE) AS a,CAST(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN 9 WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 5 END AS DOUBLE) AS b FROM bench WHERE id < 7
